benefit: Viewers learn why a film made of well-timed shots can still feel like a slideshow, and the one rule that fixes it: give every cut something that carries the eye across.
proofAction: A gaze marker jumps and searches after every cut of a three-panel slideshow; four carries are shown one by one; the same three panels rebuilt with carries let the marker glide in one path.
reference: reference.md (no external moving reference; the rule is the project's own, adapted in its own words from references/reference-skill-onetake.md, ideas only)

assets.license: generated with Strudel (AGPL-3.0 tool, not bundled); built-in synth sounds only, no samples
